citations.quote:
Derivation of (C1): with mu = 1 + lambda eps the map (x, y) |-> (mu^2 x,
    mu^3 y) sends E to y^2 = x^3 + a mu^4 x + b mu^6 = x^3 + (a + 4 a lambda
    eps) x + (b + 6 b lambda eps), so for (a', b') = lambda (4a, 6b) the
    homomorphic section is the image of the constant section; ref(P) for this
    direction is (x_P, y_P + eps lambda (2 a x_P + 3 b)/y_P); the difference
    s(P) - ref(P) = eps (2 lambda x_P, 3 lambda y_P - lambda (2 a x_P + 3 b)
    / y_P), and both components equal (lambda x_P / y_P) times (2 y_P, 3 x_P^2
    + a) because 3 y_P^2 - 2 a x_P - 3 b = 3 x_P^3 + a x_P. Hence delta_triv =
    lambda x_P / y_P.
